scope.information_unit: Checksum-verified Binance COIN-M BTCUSD_PERP and ETHUSD_PERP forced-liquidation records signal-mapped to Bybit BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT.
scope.model: One pooled HistGradientBoostingClassifier and one predetermined isotonic calibration rule.
scope.features: Sixteen causal trader-readable forced-flow, prior completed market-state, funding and structural-distance values; no future MFE/MAE or post-decision flow.
scope.actions: One cost-adjusted LONG/SHORT/FLAT equation; one global Bybit position slot.
scope.exits: Frozen external-liquidity target, structural stop or source-gap adverse settlement; no elapsed-time liquidation.
scope.chronology: Fit through 2022H1, calibrate 2022H2, confirm 2023H1, conditional development/risk-cap selection 2023H2, freeze through 2023-12-31 and immediately open official 2024H1.
scope.costs: Identical 12/18/24bp account paths; actual Bybit funding when sufficiently complete, otherwise adverse 1bp per 8h for both sides.
scope.risk_search: Only after positive non-liquidated 24bp confirmation and development; 0.25%-60% planned risk and 1x-100x notional caps; choose highest positive no-liquidation 24bp growth; 1% is not a ceiling.

dependencies.required_parent_result: SOURCE_GATE_RESULT.json with parent claim ID and status PASS

result_authority: This branch creates no market outcome until the parent source gate passes. Its workflow is dormant until a post-PASS sentinel is committed.
